adminAuth.description: Internal API: ADMIN_TOKEN, plus an X-Admin-Email header naming a staff account.

post.description: Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. `amount` is an integer string in USDC base units (6 decimals). The response includes `checkout_url` for the hosted checkout page.

get.summary: List payment intents (cursor pagination, newest first)
get.description: Pass the last id of a page as `starting_after` to fetch the next page.

post.description: Allowed only while `created` or `awaiting_payment`. A wallet payload already issued stays valid on-chain until its signature expiry; a payment landing after cancellation is flagged for review, never dropped.

get.summary: Merchant totals, computed from the double-entry ledger
get.description: Derived from ledger entries on the merchant's receivable account, never by summing payment intents. Only confirmed (on-chain, final) payments and recorded refunds appear here.

post.description: Returns the signing `secret` exactly once. Deliveries carry `ClearGateway-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>">`. In production the URL must be https and must not resolve to a private address.

delete.description: Stops future deliveries; pending deliveries to it are abandoned.

post.summary: Send a test event to this endpoint
post.description: Queues a `webhook.test` event; the delivery worker sends it like any other event.

Records the request only: nothing is sent on-chain yet. `amount` (USDC base units) defaults to everything still refundable. The total of all live refunds can never exceed the amount the customer paid. Emits `refund.created`.

get.summary: List your refunds (newest first, cursor pagination)

get.description: Public endpoint scoped to one intent. Authenticate with the intent's client secret via the `x-client-secret` header (or `client_secret` query parameter for EventSource, which cannot set headers).

post.summary: Get the signed payload for paying from a connected wallet
post.description: Public endpoint scoped to one intent. Authenticate with the intent's client secret via the `x-client-secret` header (or `client_secret` query parameter for EventSource, which cannot set headers). `method=approve` returns approval + `pay` arguments; `method=authorization` returns EIP-3009 typed data for a one-signature payment via `payWithAuthorization`.

post.summary: Get (or create) a per-payment deposit address for sending USDC from an exchange
post.description: Public endpoint scoped to one intent. Authenticate with the intent's client secret via the `x-client-secret` header (or `client_secret` query parameter for EventSource, which cannot set headers). Idempotent: returns the same address on every call. The customer sends USDC on Base to this address; the platform detects, confirms and settles the payment automatically, with no signature from the customer.

post.summary: Create a card / Apple Pay on-ramp session (Wert primary, Simplex secondary; provider picked per merchant)
post.description: Public endpoint scoped to one intent. Authenticate with the intent's client secret via the `x-client-secret` header (or `client_secret` query parameter for EventSource, which cannot set headers). The on-ramp delivers USDC to `customer_wallet_address`, which must belong to the customer (never the merchant's payout wallet, the splitter, or the USDC contract). That wallet then pays through `/wallet-payment` once funded; this endpoint never marks the intent paid.

get.summary: Server-sent events stream of status changes
get.description: Public endpoint scoped to one intent. Authenticate with the intent's client secret via the `x-client-secret` header (or `client_secret` query parameter for EventSource, which cannot set headers). Emits `status` events on change and closes once the payment reaches a final state.
